header.name: 3D Animation filmmaking (3DAF)
header.description:
This course introduces students to:
(i) Geometrical and Organic drawings
(ii) Basics of content creation for Animation and Game
(iii) Designing 3 dimensional assets for Animation and Game
(iv) Animation Principles
(v) Exporting Assets to Game Engines
prerequisites_desirable: Having basic skill of drawing and sketch

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Student should be able to understand the fundamental of asset design

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Provide basics of 3D content creation to students. They should be able to design their own 3D assets

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to animate 3D characters and assets.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to export assets to Game Engine and Render Project

lecture_topics: Concept 3D (Content creation for animation and game)
Basics of Geometrical and Organic drawing

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Lab: Introduction to 3D Sculpting in Maya
Lab: Introduction to 3D Sculpting in Maya

lecture_topics: Exporting Assets to Game Engine (Unity/ Unreal)
